text:
Maya: Quick report from a console sweep: skiplink " + ("Skip to main") doesn't land on insights table, screen reader still reads the page title. Also badge counts (new alerts) are low contrast on light theme and VoiceOver reads badge text twice. Leaving notes and a tiny repro. a11y-bot: Scan summary: 8 contrast failures (badge bg/text), 1 landmark-missing (main region not labeled), 2 duplicate-announcements on dynamic count updates. Full mock report: https://internal/reports/a11y/2005551234 Keiran: Repro steps? I couldn't repro the skiplink in ChromeVox. Maya: Steps (Safari + VoiceOver): 1) Page load > press Cmd+Option+F to jump to skiplinks 2) Activate "Skip to insights" Expected: focus lands on table with announcement like "Insights table" Actual: focus is at top of page; VO still announces H1. DOM snippet:```html a href="#insights" class="skip-link">Skip to insights

Console

Insights

...
``` Possibly focus gets stolen by JS that hydrates header. Luis: Sounds like a race between anchor focus and our React mount. Maybe we should set the skip target as a focusable region: tabindex="-1" on section and focus it on navigation. Also add role="region" aria-label so SR announces it. Tess: Badge issue: We use a yellow badge (#f2c94c) with white text on it for counts <10. Contrast is <3:1. Design suggests darker amber or dark text. Also VoiceOver reads the count and the chip label: "3 new, new". We're rendering: `3 new` which might be duplicated by aria-live updates. Maya: Good catch. For duplication, we likely have an aria-live on the parent list that announces the change and the sr-only within badge also reads it. Proposed: remove aria-live from list if the visible UI already conveys the change, or modify live text to be concise ("alerts: 3"). Also ensure sr-only is not duplicated with programmatic announcements. Keiran: Implementation plan: - Add tabindex="-1" and focus() in the hashchange handler for the skip target - Add role="region" aria-label="Insights" to the section - Update badge colors to #b77a00 (meets 4.5:1) or switch to dark text on light badge - Replace sr-only duplication with aria-describedby on the table to reference the badge id so SR reads once. Maya: Small CSS for visible skiplink focus (per a11y pattern):```css .skip-link:focus{position:static;opacity:1;outline:3px solid #005fcc;background:#fff;color:#000} ``` But keep it visually subtle in product. Also add prefers-reduced-motion to skip any focus animations. Tess: For dynamic updates, prefer aria-atomic=false on live regions and update only numeric text nodes. That reduces verbosity. Also test with VoiceOver + NVDA. a11y-bot: Extra checks: ensure h2 has scope where tables used in page; add aria-describedby reference to table caption for context; run axe/pa11y after changes. Luis: I'll make a small PR: focusable skip target + region label, badge color tokens update, and remove duplicate live text. Will include VoiceOver notes and a short recording. Assigning to @Keiran for review. :thumbsup:
